camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise ListDataLakeTableName --region cn-hangzhou --CatalogName hive --DbName default --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries a list of names of tables in a data lake
description_zh: 调用此API可获取数据湖表名列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-data-lake-table-name --data-region cn-hangzhou --catalog-name hive --db-name default --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakeTableName

parameters.help_en: The region where the data lake resides
parameters.name: data_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The regular expression that is used to match the table name
parameters.help_zh: 数据表名称匹配正则表达式
parameters.name: table_name_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, there is no next page.
If a value of NextToken is returned, it indicates the token that is used for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data table. Valid values:

MANAGED_TABLE
EXTERNAL_TABLE
VIRTUAL_VIEW
INDEX_TABLE
MATERIALIZED_VIEW
parameters.help_zh:
数据表的类型，取值如下：

MANAGED_TABLE：内部表。

EXTERNAL_TABLE：外部表。

VIRTUAL_VIEW：虚拟视图。

INDEX_TABLE：索引表。

MATERIALIZED_VIEW：物化视图
parameters.name: table_type

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The number of records per page

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
